                  "beta tester badges",

                  "static campfire",
                  "hidden cave"

                  "grim faces"

                "location_end_label": "Null-Zone - Hidden Camp",
                "location_start": "Null-Zone - Hidden Camp",

                  "holographic map",
                  "pulsing red icon",
                  "blue light projection",
                  "grim faces"

                  "floating UI panel"

                  "determined faces"

                "location_end": "Null-Zone - Portal Gate",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_PORTAL_GATE_D3FA54",
                "location_end_label": "Null-Zone - Portal Gate",
                "location_start": "Null-Zone - Portal Gate",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_PORTAL_GATE_D3FA54",
                "location_start_label": "Null-Zone - Portal Gate",
                "outcome": "End of Book 1.",
                "scene_id": 10,
                "summary": "Artie looks at the sky and says, 'I hope the next world has better drop rates,' before stepping into a portal.",

                  "swirling portal",

                  "wireframe ground"

                "transition_in_text": "Artie's foot touches the edge of the swirling vortex, the code beginning to pull him in.",

            "section_id": 3,
            "title": "The First Step"
